'''Klaus-Dieter Hungenberg''' (born 14 September 1953) is a German chemist and professor at the [[University of Paderborn]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Professorship at Paderborn|url=http://www.uni-paderborn.de/mitteilung/117691/|accessdate=17 September 2013}}{{Dead link|date=March 2026 |bot=InternetArchiveBot }}</ref> Hungenberg has contributed to the field of [[Chemical kinetics|reaction kinetics]] for polymerization processes, and has been honored with [[Professorship]] for his contributions in the field of reaction chemistry at the Institute for Polymer Material and Process (PMP), [[University of Paderborn]].

== Education ==
Hungenberg studied [[Chemistry]] at the [[University of Essen|University of Duisburg-Essen]] and then received his Diploma in [[Anionic addition polymerization|Anionic polymerization]] in 1979. Later, he received his PhD in 1982 in the group of Friedhelm Bandermann at the University of Duisburg-Essen with research projects focusing on [[Living polymerization|anionic living free radical polymerization]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.uni-due.de/tchem/fb/publik.pdf|title=PhD thesis}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.uni-due.de/tchem/fb/indexen.htm|title=Group of Prof. Bandermann}}</ref>

==Biography==
From 1983 to 1987 Hungenberg worked in process development for blood diagnostic devices with [[Boehringer Mannheim|Boehringer Mannheim GmbH]], now [[Roche Diagnostics]].

In 1987, he joined [[BASF]]’s Polymer research group. Since then, he has led diverse product and process development projects ranging from new [[Polyvinyl chloride|PVC]] modifiers,<ref>{{cite web|title=Patent on two stage emulsion polymerization|url=https://patents.google.com/patent/DE4041186A1/en}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Patent on PVC|url=https://patents.google.com/patent/EP0483529B1/fr?oq=EP0483529A1%2C+HUNGENBERG+KLAUS+DIETER+DR+%2C+LYNCH+JOHN+DR}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Patent on PVC process|url=https://patents.google.com/patent/EP0483529A1/en?oq=High+impact+PVC+composition+with+good+transparency++hungenberg}}</ref> polyolefin processes,<ref>{{cite web|title=Patent on Polyolefin|url=https://patents.google.com/patent/EP0480190B1/en?oq=Polypropylene+wax+with+high+hardness+and+crystallinity+hungenberg}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Polyolefin process|url=https://patents.google.com/patent/EP0463406B1/en?oq=Propylene%2A+polymers+production+with+broad+mol.wt.+ratio++by++hungenberg}}</ref> catalysis,<ref name="Work on Catalysis">{{cite book|last=Hungenberg|first=K. K. D. Hungenberg has been at different leadership positions in [[BASF]] SE for many years. In 2004, he was named Research Director of Polymer Reaction Engineering at [[BASF]] SE. In 2010, he was appointed as Vice President Polymer Reaction Engineering in recognition for his achievements. In 2012 Hungenberg received an Honorary [[Professorship]] at the institute of Polymer, Materials and Processes (PMP), [[University of Paderborn]]. There he regularly gives lectures about Polymer Reaction Engineering and the Modeling of Polymer Processes. He is highly networked in the area of Polymer Reaction Engineering and is known globally for his contributions in this field.

Furthermore, he is an Editorial Board member of several international journals and acted as chairman and member for Scientific Committees of various conferences. He is engaged in the [[International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry|IUPAC]] Working Party "Modeling of Kinetics and Processes of Polymerization",<ref name="IUPAC">{{cite web|last=Hungenberg |first=K. D. |title=IUPAC |url=http://www.iupac.org/nc/home/about/members-and-committees/member-and-people/member-details.html?tx_wfqbe_pi1%5BACT_CONTACTID%5D=E3162330-6D9A-4082-A812-DEACE23D318E |archive-url=https://archive.today/20130917170137/http://www.iupac.org/nc/home/about/members-and-committees/member-and-people/member-details.html?tx_wfqbe_pi1%5BACT_CONTACTID%5D=E3162330-6D9A-4082-A812-DEACE23D318E |url-status=dead |archive-date=17 September 2013 |accessdate=17 September 2013 }}</ref> the Working Party “Polymer Reaction Engineering” of [[European Federation of Chemical Engineering|EFCE]]<ref>{{cite web|last=Hungenberg|first=K. D.|title=Working group EFCE|url=http://www.efce.info/home.html|accessdate=17 September 2013}}</ref> and acts as Deputy Chairman of the [[DECHEMA]] Technical Committee "Polyreaktionen".<ref>{{cite web|last=Hungenberg|first=K. D.|title=Chairman in Dechema|url=http://www.dechema.de/en/Research.html|accessdate=17 September 2013}}</ref> In addition, he is lecturer in Dechema and responsible for the training course "Polymerisationstechnik".
